[[File:Sensor_pack.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A sensor pack]]
{{Quote|Sir, sensors detected something near drone vessel 171 but it ''disappeared'' almost immediately. We think it was just an echo&hellip;''"<br />"''No, ''this'' is the moment we've been ''waiting'' for. The Rebels have made their move.|An [[Imperial Navy crewman]] and [[Unidentified Imperial captain (escort frigate)|his captain]]|<ref name="Drone Alone">{{SWComicCite|7.10|Drone Alone}}</ref>}}
A '''sensor''' was one of any of a range of complex devices that enhanced something's ability to receive data about its environment.

==History==
[[File:Falcon-ROTJGCCHVCD.jpg|left|thumb|The [[ANq-51 sensor array computer/Legends|ANq-51 sensor array]] [[Rectenna/Legends|rectenna]] dish on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]]]
All [[Starship/Legends|starships]] carried sensors, as did most vehicles and [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Depending on the sensor, they could detect and analyze many forms of data, such as electromagnetic [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]], sound and vibration, [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], nuclear radiation, magnetic fields, heat, pressure, trace chemicals, or the emissions of other sensors.

Sensors were, of course, not perfect. Not only could they fail to detect what they should or present false "ghost" images, they could be interfered with by natural phenomena like solar radiation, [[Hydrogen/Legends|hydrogen]] clouds, [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] fields, and potent gravity wells; and by artificial phenomena such as [[Sensor jammer/Legends|sensor jammers]], [[sensor decoy]]s, [[shield camouflage]], stealth technology, and, of course, [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking devices]].
